cell 47  [markdown]

## HERA — Step 3c: low-field extension of the electron spot check (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0, B 0.3 → 1.0 T at 4 mT

> **05:26** · sdh-spot-check low-field extension: n=+3.2e12 D=0 electron spot, B 0.3->1.0 T uniform-B 4 mT (176 pts), sr1 50 uV; pins light-tone onset for fan B\_lo · **ETA ~05:44** (≈18 min)

Runs 6/7 read (ana): the electron side is the fan side — run 6 resolves three fundamentals, **7.3 T** (light; the model's ABAB light pocket at n = 3.2 is 7.3 T), **22.3 T** (low-B windows only) and **29.9 T** (dominant above 3 T), with 7.3 + 22.3 ≈ 29.9 — an ABAB pair with its sum/breakdown tone (scale 0.90) or a {7.3, 29.9} pair with 22.3 as a 3× harmonic (scale 1.12); the fan's F(n) trajectories decide. The hole side (run 7, F_L = 12.4 T) sits in the near-CNP balanced-pair regime (6.6 T + 12.3 T ≈ F_L, pair unresolvable at δF = 0.8 T) — a preview, not a read. **Why this cell:** `sdh_onset` on run 6 flags the light 7.3 T tone *censored* at 1.0 T (SNR 96 at the fine leg's edge; the 0–1 T leg was 50 mT and cannot sample a 7 T tone), so the fan's `B_lo` is unknown below 1 T — and it is the fan's most expensive lever (uniform-1/B rows pile up at low B: B_lo = 0.6 vs 1.0 T is ≈ +1.5 h; a partner tone at n ≈ 2 needs B_lo ≲ 0.7 T for 5 periods). `landau-fan` step 1: a censored carrying tone → a cheap low-field extension pins the onset before committing the fan. Grid: uniform B, 4 mT (Δ(1/B) = 0.044 at 0.3 T = 3× Nyquist on 7.3 T), 176 pts, same gates and sensitivity as run 6 (50 µV) so amplitudes compare directly; `delay = 0` (3 s driver settle = 10 τ). Ends at 1.0 T with the gates at the spot — the fan starts within 0.5 T of there. Preconditions printed: T_sample 1.0–1.5 K, |B| < 0.05 T (handoff left 0.003 T), V_si = 0, PS/output on, nplci 1. Checkpoint: first 20 rows (signal, leakage, field tracking); read = `sdh_onset` on runs 6+ext spliced.

============================================================
```python
# === sdh-spot-check — low-field extension, electron spot (n = +3.2e12, D = 0): pins the light-tone onset -> landau-fan B_lo ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run-5 calibration (ana)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V (run 6 used the same point)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

# --- field grid: uniform in B, 4 mT, 0.3 -> 1.0 T (3x Nyquist on the 7.3 T tone at the 0.3 T edge) ---
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.3, 1.0001, 0.004), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # as run 6 (5 kOhm FS at 10 nA): amplitudes compare directly
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, 4 mT; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron low-field extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.3 -> 1.0 T, 4 mT, sr1 50 uV; pins onset for the fan B_lo"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, low-field extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.3 -> 1.0 T uniform-B 4 mT; purpose: light-tone (7.3 T) onset for landau-fan B_lo; cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 1.0 T — the fan starts from here. No park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
```

      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

# --- field grid: uniform in B, 4 mT, 0.3 -> 1.0 T (3x Nyquist on the 7.3 T tone at the 0.3 T edge) ---
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.3, 1.0001, 0.004), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # as run 6 (5 kOhm FS at 10 nA): amplitudes compare directly
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, 4 mT; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron low-field extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.3 -> 1.0 T, 4 mT, sr1 50 uV; pins onset for the fan B_lo"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, low-field extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.3 -> 1.0 T uniform-B 4 mT; purpose: light-tone (7.3 T) onset for landau-fan B_lo; cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 1.0 T — the fan starts from here. No park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
```
